To construct a monument honoring the citizens of [[Ascalon]] killed during [[the Searing]], [[Symon the Scribe]] needs an intact [[Ascalon Census|census]] to properly record their names.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = prophecies
}}

===Objectives===
* Find the Ascalon census in the ruins in [[Old Ascalon]].
* Return to Symon the Scribe for your reward.

===Reward===
* 500 [[Experience]]
* 100 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Frost Artifact]]
** [[Energy]] +6 (Requires 5 [[Water Magic]])
** Reduces [[Poison]] duration on you by 20%
** Reduces [[Bleeding]] duration on you by 20%
** [[Armor rating|Armor]] +7 (while [[Hexed]])
* [[Idol]]
** Energy +6 (Requires 5 [[Curses]])
** Armor +5 (while casting)
** Halves skill recharge of spells (Chance: 5%)

==Walkthrough==
Leave [[Ascalon City]].  Head southwest under the bridge past [[Warmaster Grast]].  Veer to the left past [[Ambassador Zain]]'s camp down into the ditch (where the river was in [[Ascalon (pre-Searing)|pre-Searing Ascalon]]) and continue heading southwest.  You'll face off against some [[Gargoyle]]s and [[Devourer]]s, but if you take on the groups one at a time, you'll have no problems getting to the [[chest (Counting the Fallen)|chest]] containing the census.

With the census in hand, go back to Ascalon City and give it to Symon the Scribe.

==Interactive objects==
* [[Chest (Counting the Fallen)|Chest]]

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Symon the Scribe
:''"King Adelbern has commissioned a monument to those who died in the Searing. I am compiling a list of the names of the fallen, but I don't have all the records I need. I believe a copy of the old '''census''' might have survived in the ruins of '''Old Ascalon'''. If you could get it for me, it would be a great help."''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I'll take care of it.
| decline = I'm sorry.  I have other things I must do.
| ask = Have you found the '''census'''? I need it to finish compiling the list of fallen for the king's monument. Lyssa willing, it'll be in the ruins in Old Ascalon.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Symon the Scribe
:''"You found the census! Oh, I'm most...grateful to you. I almost said I was delighted, but one look at this list...so many lost. If we took a census today, the list wouldn't be half this long."''

==Notes==
* Warrior primaries can complete [[Gargoyle Trouble]] while doing this quest. There are gargoyles down in the ditch that satisfy the requirements for that quest.
* A quicker route is had by starting from [[Sardelac Sanitarium]], and heading East.
